rows.name: Step 01 · One module
rows.note: The hammer cell becomes tile/6 (1.5 glyph cells), so the mark and the letters share one grid.

rows.name: Step 02 · Integer master grid
rows.note: Tile 90, glyph cell 10, hammer cell 15: every coordinate before rotation is a whole or half unit, so the SVG master is clean.

rows.name: Step 03 · Tile gap = one stroke
rows.note: The space between tiles equals one glyph cell, the letters' stroke weight.

rows.name: Step 04 · Axis on the diagonal
rows.note: Already exact in v3 (offset 0.00), now a written rule so no later step can drift it: the handle leaves through the corner symmetrically.

rows.name: Step 05 · Head clearance
rows.note: v3 jams the prong tips 6.7 units from the edges; give them one hammer cell of air on both sides.

rows.name: Step 06 · Break = one stroke
rows.note: The head-to-handle break equals one glyph cell, the same as the gap between tiles: the 'break' in the mark rhymes with the wordmark.

rows.name: Step 07 · Optical centre
rows.note: Centre the figure (the head), not the bleeding handle: head centroid sits 2% above-right of the tile centre.

rows.name: Step 08 · M reads M
rows.note: The full-height middle stem makes M read as 'III' or a lowercase m; stop it at mid-height.

rows.name: Step 09 · A: clipped shoulders?
rows.note: Test clipped top corners against the v3 square A at small sizes.

rows.name: Step 10 · B: waist notch
rows.note: A one-cell notch at mid-right keeps B from reading as 8 or 日.

rows.name: Step 11 · Even typographic colour
rows.note: From a distance each tile should look equally grey; the hammer tile was the heaviest.

rows.name: Step 12 · Micro radius
rows.note: Round only the tile corners (0.4 cell) so the blocks feel made, not printed; the pixels stay square.

rows.name: Step 13 · Ink and paper
rows.note: A near-black with a trace of green and a warm white: still reads pure black-and-white.

rows.name: Step 14 · BAM Green
rows.note: One green, the Forest you liked on the Cube Net, checked for text contrast.

rows.name: Step 15 · Green highlight rule
rows.note: The hammer tile is the only thing that may turn green; B-A-M stay ink.

rows.name: Step 16 · Stream accents
rows.note: Colour only appears when a stream is being talked about, matched to the bins on the floor.

rows.name: Step 17 · Reverse + photo keyline
rows.note: On dark, tiles flip to paper with ink glyphs; on photos a one-cell paper keyline keeps the edge.

rows.name: Step 18 · Hand-hinted favicons
rows.note: 16 px is a 1-bit pixel drawing, not a blurry downscale; 32 px is tuned the same way.

rows.name: Step 19 · Lockup family
rows.note: Horizontal, stacked, icon, wordmark and descriptor lockups with one clear-space and minimum-size rule.

rows.name: Step 20 · Production files
rows.note: SVG masters, PNG favicons and favicon.ico, each re-imported to prove it renders.

rows.name: Grid Purist, production files
rows.note: SVG masters (mark, horizontal, stacked, wordmark, descriptor, reverse versions) and favicons.
